title: FloodGuard Companion Relief on the RentGuard Discount-Stop Charge
content:
**Desk guidance — RentGuard Renters Policy, stop relief for a flood companion.** A renter who also insures the rental address under the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy earns relief points on the charge owed when the multi-policy discount on the renters policy stops.

**Rule.** When the customer holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force insuring the same address as the renters rental address and at least 2 FloodGuard premium payments were received in the last 24 calendar months, 20 relief points apply to the discount-stop charge; when that FloodGuard policy is in force at the same address but fewer than 2 FloodGuard premium payments were received in the last 24 calendar months, 10 relief points apply; otherwise no flood relief points apply.

### What the records must show

- On the FloodGuard record: status in force, and a property address that is the same address as the rental address on the RentGuard policy.
- On the FloodGuard premium account: the premium payments received, counted over the last 24 calendar months.

### Points of judgement

| FloodGuard policy in force at the rental address | FloodGuard premium payments received, last 24 calendar months | Relief points |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 20 |
| Yes | 0 or 1 | 10 |
| Yes, but at a different address | any | 0 |
| No FloodGuard policy in force | any | 0 |

Hypothetical boundary: a FloodGuard policy in force at the rental address with exactly 2 premium payments received in the last 24 calendar months gives 20 relief points; with exactly 1 it gives 10.
